name: security-audit-skill
description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
one_liner: A recipe that turns an AI coding assistant into a security auditor: it methodically hunts for vulnerabilities in a codebase and writes up a verified report the way a professional pentester would.
buyer: A boutique security consulting firm that wants to offer faster, cheaper first-pass audits to more clients.
business_use_cases: A freelance security consultant runs it on a client's codebase overnight, then spends billable hours only verifying and deepening the strongest findings.
A startup preparing for a SOC2 audit uses it to self-scan and fix obvious issues before paying an external auditor.
An open-source maintainer runs it before every major release to catch vulnerabilities before disclosure gets embarrassing.

money_ideas.idea: Offer 'AI-assisted security audit' packages at a fraction of a traditional pentest price
Bundle it into a recurring 'continuous security review' retainer for startups

steal_this: This weekend, run it against 10 popular open-source repos, write up the findings responsibly, and use the results as a portfolio to sell audit services.
